body.p: During in-progress operations, the Git Client informs the user of the current operation on Git Staging and visualises it in the source tree on Git History.
The Git Staging view shows a state label (for example, Merging...).

fig.title: Git Staging view during a merge conflict

body.p:
The Git History view shows an amber Start (Mine) label next to the current commit and labels the source commit according to the current in-progress operation:
Merge: Incoming (Theirs) appears next to the merge source commit.
Cherry-pick: Cherry-picked commit appears next to the cherry-picked commit.
Revert: Reverted commit appears next to the commit being reverted.
To help you visualise in-progress operations, the Git Client draws a dashed grey line from the merge source to the current branch's Uncommitted changes node.

fig.title: Git History view during a merge conflict
